scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('fs').chmodSync('dist/apps/cli/phosphor.js', 0o755)" && npm run build:extension
scripts.check:browser: npm run build && node tests/browser/live-filter.check.ts && node tests/browser/extension.check.ts
scripts.graph: graphify extract . --code-only && graphify cluster-only . && echo '\nCode graph: http://localhost:8765/graph.html  (Ctrl-C to stop)\n' && python3 -m http.server 8765 --bind 127.0.0.1 -d graphify-out
